newsitem.title: UK: UK Premier Farnell says current yr unchanged.
newsitem.headline: UK Premier Farnell says current yr unchanged.

text.p: British electronic components group Premier Farnell Plc said on Tuesday its UK and U.S. catalogue businesses had not experienced much change in trading conditions in the first three months of the current financial year.
Premier's UK and U.S. catalogue businesses represent two-thirds of the group's operations.

"I have to report that, in the first three months of the new financial year, there has been no discernible change in the trading conditions being experienced by our principle UK and U.S. catalogue businesses," chairman Malcolm Bates told the annual meeting.

He said the company had maintained the improvements seen at the start of the year in mainland Europe and Australia. The company's newer businesses in Singapore, Malaysia and Hong Kong also started well.
The company's share price was a penny down at 462-1/2 pence.
